description: Founded in 1936, Taylor Morrison Home Corporation is a land developer and homebuilder that designs, builds, and sells single-family and multifamily detached and attached homes. It also develops various types of planned communities. Under the Urban Form brand name, it develops and constructs multiuse properties that include commercial space, as well as multifamily properties. Under the Yardly brand, it operates a build-to-rent homebuilding business. Other brands it holds include Darling Homes Collection by Taylor Morrison and Esplanade.

rankings.title: 100 Best Large Workplaces for Women
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"What makes this company a great place to work really comes down to how it feels to be here. From the beginning, I've felt genuinely respected and appreciated as a person, not just for the job I do. People take the time to listen, and that makes you feel comfortable sharing ideas or speaking up. There's a lot of trust, which gives you the confidence to do your work and keep learning along the way. When things get busy, there's real teamwork; people help each other because they want to, not because they have to. That kind of environment makes a big difference, and it's what makes coming to work every day feel meaningful, not just routine."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Construction
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"The culture of the company and specifically the division I work in is very supportive and encouraging. The management team is intentional about the ways they show up and model the type of culture that we want to thrive here. We are encouraged to seek collaborations that promote efficiencies, shared resources and create innovations to better everyone in the division. Time off is encouraged regularly, and personal life needs are met with understanding and accommodations whenever necessary. Our people focused culture is important to me and others. Having our management team respect our individuality and treat us as people first and employees second is unique and very much appreciated!"

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Construction
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"The company's strong commitment to building not just homes, but thriving communities, is unique. There's a deep sense of purpose in knowing that our work has a lasting impact on families and neighborhoods. The culture here supports innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, especially in cross-functional roles like mine, where land development, HOA management, and resident experience intersect. Leaders truly empower employees to lead with integrity and heart, which makes it both fulfilling and inspiring to be part of the team."
